meta.description: The place where Changemakers clubs find each other, plan projects and share events.

landing.h1: Build projects that change the world
landing.sub: The place where Changemakers clubs find each other, plan projects and share events.
landing.teacherLink: Are you a teacher? Start here
landing.how1: Start a club at your school, or join one with a code from your teacher.
landing.how2: Plan a project: the problem, your action, the evidence, and what you learned.
landing.how3: Share your events and invite other clubs.
landing.principle1: Built for changemakers, not for addiction
landing.principle1Body: No ads. No engagement algorithms. No dopamine loops. Just real tools for real change.
landing.principle2Body: Lists have a finite end. When you're done, you're done — go build something.
landing.principle3: A club network designed around doing, not scrolling.
landing.principle3Body: Every screen leads somewhere: a project, a task, an event. Not just another like.
landing.learnStartBody: What you need, and how your teacher gets verified.
landing.learnJoinBody: Get a code from your club, or an invite from your teacher.
landing.learnTeachersBody: How verification works, and what you can see and approve.
landing.learnSafetyBody: What we collect, who can see it, and how to report a problem.
landing.finalLine: Join the Changemaker network and start building with others.

strands.natureLine: Climate, conservation, and regeneration projects that restore the natural world.
strands.economyLine: Circular systems, ethical jobs, and fair access to opportunity and resources.
strands.societyLine: Community, inclusion, and justice — building belonging for everyone.
strands.wellbeingLine: Health, safety, and belonging — for people and the planet alike.

teachers.title: For teachers and advisors
teachers.intro: Every club on the network has a teacher advisor. Here is how you get verified, and what you can see.
teachers.step1: Sign up with your school email address.
teachers.step2: A second contact at your school, the head or the safeguarding lead, confirms who you are.
teachers.step3: Our team approves you, and you turn on an authenticator app.
teachers.step4: We check again once a year.
teachers.seeTitle: What you can see and approve
teachers.seeBody: Everything in your club: updates, projects, events, threads and the member list. You approve anything public, every photo, and every student under 16 who joins.
teachers.safeBody: There are no private messages. Students show only a first name and initial, inside their own club. Places are cities, never schools. Photos appear only after you approve them.

ideas.title: Need an idea?
ideas.intro: Starter ideas for {strand}. Pick one and make it your own.
nature: Weigh your school's rubbish for a week, then cut the biggest kind.
Turn a corner of the school grounds into flowers for bees.
Check empty classrooms at break and switch off lights and screens.
Map your school's taps and ask for a refill point, so fewer bottles are bought.
economy: Collect outgrown uniforms and swap them before term starts.
Fix bikes, clothes and chargers with volunteers who know how.
Run a market where prices are low and nothing goes to waste.
Raise money for a cause and show where every euro goes.
society: Pair new students with an older buddy for their first month.
Collect food for a local food bank and help sort it.
A weekly lunch table where students practise each other's languages.
Find the places in school that are hard to reach, and ask for changes.
wellbeing: Open a calm room in exam weeks, with simple rules.
A short walk before school, twice a week, for anyone who wants to come.
One lunch a week without phones. Count how many join.
A wall where students leave thank-you notes for each other.
